text_block_list.text: A promotional video shoot for the Satono Resort was scheduled on a deserted island, and I came along to help out.
The title of the video was simply—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
"If you could bring just one item to a deserted island?"
—Now, what will your choice be, Vivlos-san?
True to the title, various items had been prepared. Everything from practical survival tools to novelty variety goods.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Heeey☆ Here's what I chose!
A "Tropical Drink"♪
choice_data_list: (...A tropical drink?)

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Oh...? Are you quite sure about that?
There are many practical items available, though...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yep, this is totally fine!
Because Papa always told me!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "Whenever you have the chance to enjoy yourself, enjoy it to the fullest! That's how life becomes truly fulfilling"—he said!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: So even on a deserted island, I'm gonna get into the resort mood with a tropical drink and have a blast~☆
choice_data_list: (I see...)

text_block_list.text: While it would probably be a terrible choice on a real deserted island, today was just a shoot for a few hours. The recording went smoothly without a hitch.
Or so we thought—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Whaaat...!? The boat back can't move because of engine trouble!?
choice_data_list: (What!?)

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: Yes, a replacement boat has been dispatched to pick us up, so please wait a little while...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Hey, isn't this turning into a huge deal...? A-Are we gonna be okay~...?
choice_data_list: Yeah... I think we'll be fine once the replacement boat arrives.
Yeah... I think we'll be fine once the replacement boat arrives.

text_block_list.text: And so we ended up waiting for the replacement boat, but as time passed, the sun grew even hotter—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: So hot~~... I'm gonna melt~~~...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: And my tropical drink is all gone too... What do I dooo~~...
Under this blazing sun and heat, heatstroke was just around the corner. ...At this rate, we're in trouble.
choice_data_list: (Alright, let's borrow some props from the shoot...!)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Wah... A parasol!?
You went and got one for me!?
choice_data_list: We can't afford you getting heatstroke, after all.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much~~...! ...Haaa~~. The shade feels so nice~...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: KYAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!!
choice_data_list: Whoa...! What happened!?
Whoa...! What happened!?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: B-B-B-Bug! A buuug...!! It's squiggly and has weird colors...!!
choice_data_list: A-Alright, I'll get rid of it, so calm down!

text_block_list.text: Finding bug spray among the survival props, I successfully repelled the oddly colored bug—!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Y-You saved meee~... Uuu, that color and weird wriggling... I hope it doesn't show up in my dreams~...!
Handling the various troubles unique to a deserted island took time, and soon the sun began to set.
It would be dangerous once it got dark and we couldn't see our footing, so I decided to borrow a lantern and light it.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: The lantern is so cute~!
choice_data_list: It's going to get dark, so watch your step.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Okay! —You know, thank you soooo much for everything today!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I caused so much trouble, didn't I? ...Actually, I was kind of regretting it.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Picking a tropical drink first thing might have been the wrong move after all~...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Like, if I had chosen a tent, maybe I could have managed on my own, right?
choice_data_list: Well... maybe so.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: All the things you did for me, I bet Onee-chan usually does that kind of stuff for me all the time.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Whenever I was having fun, Onee-chan was always having a tough time behind the scenes, wasn't she~...
choice_data_list: We shouldn't forget to be grateful from now on.
We shouldn't forget to be grateful from now on.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Next time, I'm gonna try helping out too!
Vivlos has an honest and pure-hearted personality. Perhaps thanks to this unusual experience, she seemed to gain a lot of new insights.
choice_data_list: I hope you always treasure that innocence of yours.
I hope you always treasure that innocence of yours.
You've really grown up.

text_block_list.text: Vivlos has an honest and pure-hearted personality. Perhaps thanks to this unusual experience, she seemed to gain a lot of new insights.
choice_data_list: I hope you always treasure that innocence of yours.
I hope you always treasure that innocence of yours.
You've really grown up.

text_block_list.text: While paying attention to practical matters is important, her innocence is also a precious strength. I told her that she should treasure it.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Eh? Really?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... I see~! Yeah, maybe so!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Onee-chan often praises me saying "Vivlos is so honest", too! I'll make sure to cherish this properly☆

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Right~? Maybe from now on, I'll lean harder and harder into adult charm♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Now that that's settled, I'll do my best helping pack up to head back!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: First is cleaning up the trash! If there are any empty drink cups, I'll collect them all~!
